decisions.reason: Substantial investment in a multi-model line and prominent home-page placement create sunk costs and public commitment that make dropping harder.
Its home-page presence and close fit with established craftsmanship create visible commitment, while little suggests results have been so poor as to overcome escalation.
As a publicly announced flagship with multiple models and central direction, dropping it would write off major investment and expose a highly visible mistake, so escalation strongly favors keeping.
Although distant, it received its own page and a second edition, signaling ongoing investment and public commitment that make management more likely to escalate commitment despite any disappointment.
Only briefly mentioned and lacking prominent placement or clear investment, it has little sunk cost or public commitment to justify, so management is more likely to drop when results disappoint.
Building on an established offer and featured on the home page, it carries visible commitment and sunk costs that favor persistence.
